statement: The pinned out-of-tree xpadneo Bluetooth HID match table includes Elite Series 2 products 0x0b05 and 0x0b22; its event handling can forward four grip events only in its default profile and expose ABS_PROFILE, after descriptor-dependent paddle usage handling. Its normalized HID identity, auxiliary nodes, driver-selection rules and HID report output differ from stock hid-microsoft; xpadneo behavior must not be asserted as the stock kernel's evdev shape.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: xpadneo core.c:34-71, events.c:145-195 and 284-371, device.c:240-260, xpadneo.h:19-105; GPL-2.0-only source paraphrased; no device tested.
